personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean layout combined with 7 Dark-First Utility aesthetics
personality_one_liner: A pristine, minimal, monochrome AI assistant that feels like a native OS level feature—dark-first, precise, and completely free of visual noise.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-like margins, 16px screen padding, 12px gaps between cards.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar.
Use blur on the floating chat input bar.
Use blur on sticky headers when scrolling.
dont's: Do not use blur on message bubbles.
Do not use blur on model cards.

screens.name: Splash

states.loading: Centered minimalist abstract sphere logo pulsing.

screens.layout: Centered logo (image) with 'NASUKI' wordmark in display font below it. Clean surface background.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.layout: Carousel with abstract monochrome illustrations. Large typography for headlines. Sticky 'Get Started' brandPrimary button at bottom inside safe area.

screens.name: Login

screens.name: AI Chat

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the monochrome palette. Do not add any blues, purples, or random accent colors. The primary 'accent' is purely contrast (White in Dark mode, Black in Light mode).
Implement the 'Dark-first' feel by using surfaceSecondary (#18181B) heavily for cards and bubbles against the #09090B surface background in dark mode.
For the AI Chat screen, use a floating input bar wrapped in a glassmorphism container (expo-blur) at the bottom, so the chat bubbles scroll underneath it.
User chat bubbles should be high contrast (brandPrimary), AI chat bubbles should be low contrast (surfaceSecondary).
ModelCards must display dynamic download states (button -> progress bar -> complete). Use standard React Native progress bars.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all tabs and components. Keep weights uniform.
For the bottom tab bar, implement a glass effect. Ensure content scrolls properly behind it.
